title: Tail-excluded median-of-R(k)/S_unit(k) singular-series fit (2C2) — kmax=80
context: E62 (kmax=40) AGREEMENT 1.395/1.451 and E63 (N=1e7) 1.459/1.470. E64 (kmax=80, all bins) MISS at 0.933/1.075: the sparse large-k bins hold N(k)=0 or 1, so R(k) is 0 or a very large number, and half of them sit at 0, dragging the median down. E65 excludes bins with N(k)=0 (a measurement decision — a bin with no observed events cannot estimate R(k)) and takes the median over the rest at kmax=80. Reports both baselines and the exclusion rate.
rel_half: no 1/2 in gen/score; tail-excluded median fit 0.934/1.075 at kmax=80 (E62 kmax=40 1.395/1.451, Δ -0.311; E64 raw 0.933/1.075, Δ +0.001); bins used 39/40; D 0.975/1.009
verdict: MISS — G3 miss: 0.934/1.075 vs 1.32032±0.15 (E62 kmax=40 1.395/1.451, Δ -0.311; E64 raw 0.933/1.075, Δ +0.001). Tail exclusion did not recover E62; N(k)=0 is not the only pathology.
